title: Strategija i istraživanje tržišta
Strategy and market research
summary: Persone, konkurencija, pozicioniranje, USP i funnel uz AI.
Personas, competitors, positioning, USP and the funnel with AI.

q: Što je persona?
What is a persona?
options: Profil idealnog kupca temeljen na podacima
A profile of the ideal customer based on data
An invented character for a logo
explain: Persona vodi odluke o poruci i kanalu.
A persona guides decisions on message and channel.

q: AI persona može zamijeniti razgovore sa stvarnim kupcima.
An AI persona can replace conversations with real customers.
explain: AI sažima i predlaže, ali stvarne kupce moraš pitati.
AI summarizes and suggests, but you must ask real customers.

q: Profil idealnog kupca s ciljevima i problemima zove se ___.
A profile of the ideal customer with goals and problems is called a ___.
explain: Dobra persona ima cilj, bol, prigovor i kanal.
A good persona has a goal, pain, objection and channel.

q: Spojite dio persone s primjerom.
Match the persona part with an example.
explain: Ova četiri polja pokrivaju većinu odluka.
These four fields cover most decisions.

q: Složite izradu persone uz AI.
Order building a persona with AI.
steps: Zatraži od AI-ja grupiranje i sažetak
Ask AI to cluster and summarize
explain: Validacija s ljudima je ključni korak.
Validation with people is the key step.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?

t: Napravi 5 persona.
Make 5 personas.
why: Više bez podataka je više nagađanja.
More without data is more guessing.

t: Iz ovih 20 anonimiziranih odgovora ankete izdvoji 3 segmenta: cilj, bol, prigovor, kanal. Označi što je iz podataka, a što pretpostavka.
From these 20 anonymized survey answers extract 3 segments: goal, pain, objection, channel. Mark what comes from the data and what is assumption.
why: Stvarni podaci, struktura i razlikovanje činjenica od pretpostavki.
Real data, structure and separating fact from assumption.

t: Zamisli idealnog kupca.
Imagine the ideal customer.

explain: Anonimiziraj podatke prije unosa.
Anonymize data before entering it.

q: Što AI ne može sam umjesto tebe?
What can AI not do on its own for you?
options: Saznati što stvarni kupci stvarno rade i misle
Find out what real customers actually do and think
explain: Trebaju mu tvoji stvarni podaci.
It needs your real data.

q: Označavanje pretpostavki sprječava da nagađanje zamijenimo činjenicom.
Marking assumptions prevents us from mistaking guesses for facts.
explain: Pretpostavke se testiraju, činjenice se koriste.
Assumptions get tested, facts get used.

q: Spojite pojam sa značenjem.
Match the term with its meaning.
pairs: What makes you unique to the customer
Mjesto u glavi kupca prema konkurenciji
Your place in the customer's mind versus competitors
The path from awareness to purchase
explain: Ovo je rječnik svake strategije.
This is the vocabulary of every strategy.

q: Koji sadržaj ide na vrh funnela (TOFU)?
What content belongs at the top of the funnel (TOFU)?
explain: Vrh funnela gradi svjesnost.
The top of the funnel builds awareness.

q: Analizu konkurencije AI radi iz javnih izvora, a svaku tvrdnju treba provjeriti.
AI builds a competitor analysis from public sources and every claim must be checked.
explain: Cijene i značajke provjeri na službenim stranicama.
Check prices and features on official sites.

q: U SWOT-u su Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities i ___.
In SWOT the letters stand for Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and ___.
explain: Snage i slabosti su unutarnje, prilike i prijetnje vanjske.
Strengths and weaknesses are internal, opportunities and threats external.

q: Složite faze funnela.
Order the funnel stages.
explain: Svaka faza traži drukčiji sadržaj.
Each stage needs different content.

q: Koja je jača USP poruka?
Which USP message is stronger?
a: Naš proizvod je najbolji na tržištu.
Our product is the best on the market.
b: Za male timove bez dizajnera: gotov predložak za 10 minuta, bez ugovorne obveze.
For small teams without designers: a ready template in 10 minutes, no contract.
explain: Konkretno, za koga i s dokazivom koristi.
Specific, for whom and with a provable benefit.

q: Šalješ AI-ju javne opise 3 konkurenta. Na što paziš?
You send AI the public descriptions of 3 competitors. What do you watch for?
options: Koristiš samo javne podatke i provjeravaš cijene na izvoru
You use only public data and verify prices at the source
explain: Internim dokumentima konkurencije ne pristupamo.
We don't access competitors' internal documents.

q: Napišite prompt za analizu 3 konkurenta s tablicom.
Write a prompt for analyzing 3 competitors with a table.

label: Navodi 3 konkurenta
Names 3 competitors
hint: State how many and which competitors.

label: Određuje stupce usporedbe (cijena, ponuda, ton)
Sets comparison columns (price, offer, tone)
hint: Dodaj stupce: cijena, ponuda, ton, prednost.
Add columns: price, offer, tone, advantage.

label: Ograničava na javne izvore i traži izvore
Limits to public sources and asks for sources
hint: Dodaj: samo javni podaci, navedi poveznice.
Add: public data only, include links.

label: Traži tablicu
Asks for a table
hint: Ask for the output as a table.

model: Ti si analitičar tržišta. Usporedi 3 konkurenta (navedi ih) u tablici po stupcima: cijena, ponuda, ton komunikacije, glavna prednost. Koristi samo javne podatke i uz svaku tvrdnju navedi poveznicu na izvor.
You are a market analyst. Compare 3 competitors (list them) in a table with columns: price, offer, tone of communication, main advantage. Use only public data and add a source link to every claim.

explain: Stupci i izvori čine usporedbu provjerljivom.
Columns and sources make the comparison verifiable.

title: Copywriting i glas brenda
Copywriting and brand voice
summary: Formule, naslovi, emailovi, landing stranice i dosljedan glas.
Formulas, headlines, emails, landing pages and a consistent voice.

q: Spojite formulu s opisom.
Match the formula with its description.
explain: Formule su kostur. Sadržaj dolazi iz poznavanja kupca.
Formulas are a skeleton. Content comes from knowing the customer.

q: Koja formula pristaje oglasu koji počinje bolnim problemom?
Which formula fits an ad that opens with a painful problem?
explain: PAS počinje problemom, pojačava ga i nudi rješenje.
PAS opens with the problem, intensifies it and offers the solution.

q: Naslov treba obećati konkretnu korist.
A headline should promise a concrete benefit.
explain: Korist pobjeđuje značajku.
Benefit beats feature.

q: AIDA: Attention, Interest, Desire i ___.
AIDA: Attention, Interest, Desire and ___.
explain: Zadnji korak je jasan poziv na akciju.
The final step is a clear call to action.

q: Koji naslov je jači?
Which headline is stronger?
b: Stol koji se prilagodi tvojim leđima za 10 sekundi
A desk that adapts to your back in 10 seconds
explain: Konkretna korist i brojka.
A concrete benefit and a number.

q: Kako od AI-ja dobiti bolje naslove?
How do you get better headlines from AI?
options: Traži 20 varijanti u različitim kutovima, pa biraj i dorađuj
Ask for 20 variants in different angles, then pick and refine
explain: Količina pa selekcija daje kvalitetu.
Quantity then selection gives quality.

q: Složite proces izrade naslova.
Order the headline process.
explain: Test odlučuje, ne ukus.
The test decides, not taste.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?
bad: Write a headline for the webinar.

t: Napiši dobar naslov koji privlači.
Write a good headline that attracts.
Napiši 10 naslova za besplatni webinar o AI-ju za marketing timove. Kutovi: korist, radoznalost, hitnost. Do 60 znakova, bez klišeja i uskličnika.
Write 10 headlines for a free AI webinar for marketing teams. Angles: benefit, curiosity, urgency. Up to 60 characters, no clichés or exclamation marks.
Napiši naslov na 500 riječi.
Write a headline of 500 words.

explain: Kutovi daju raznolikost.
Angles give variety.

title: Email, landing stranica i glas brenda
Email, landing page and brand voice

q: Kakav je dobar predmet emaila?
What is a good email subject line?
options: Kratak i konkretan, do otprilike 45 znakova
Short and specific, up to roughly 45 characters
explain: Na mobitelu se vidi samo početak.
On mobile only the beginning shows.

q: Landing stranica ima jedan cilj i jedan CTA.
A landing page has one goal and one CTA.
explain: Manje izbora, više konverzija.
Fewer choices, more conversions.

q: Glas brenda definiraju pridjevi tona i ___ tekstova.
Brand voice is defined by tone adjectives and ___ of texts.
explain: Primjeri uče model bolje od opisa.
Examples teach the model better than descriptions.

q: Složite redoslijed landing stranice.
Order a landing page.
explain: Redoslijed vodi čitatelja prema odluci.
The order leads the reader to a decision.

q: Spojite element landinga s ulogom.
Match the landing element with its role.
explain: Dokaz mora biti stvaran, ne izmišljen.
Proof must be real, not invented.

q: Koji email je bolji?
Which email is better?
a: Pozdrav! Imamo mnogo novosti u našoj ponudi.
Hello! We have lots of news in our offer.
b: Tvoj servis bicikla ističe. Rezerviraj termin do petka.
Your bike service is due. Book a slot by Friday.
explain: Specifično, relevantno i s rokom.
Specific, relevant and with a deadline.

q: Dodirnite izmišljen dokaz u tekstu landing stranice.
Tap the invented proof in the landing page text.
segments: Naš alat štedi vrijeme pri izvještavanju.
Our tool saves time on reporting.
„Povećao je naš prihod za 340%”, kaže Marko K., direktor tvrtke Alfa d.o.o.
“It increased our revenue by 340%,” says Marko K., director of Alfa Ltd.
explain: AI često izmišlja recenzije i brojke. Koristi samo stvarne uz dopuštenje.
AI often invents reviews and numbers. Use only real ones with permission.

q: Napišite prompt koji uči model glas vašeg brenda uz primjer.
Write a prompt that teaches the model your brand voice with an example.

label: Navodi što izbjegavati
Says what to avoid
hint: Dodaj popis riječi i fraza koje ne koristimo.
Add words and phrases we don't use.

model: Ti si copywriter brenda „Kruh i sol”. Glas: topao, duhovit, bez žargona. Primjer našeg teksta: „Hrskavo do zadnje mrvice.” Napiši email od 80 riječi o novom raženom kruhu u istom glasu. Izbjegavaj klišeje poput „revolucionarno”.

You are the copywriter of “Bread and Salt”. Voice: warm, witty, no jargon. Sample of our text: “Crisp to the last crumb.” Write an 80-word email about the new rye bread in the same voice. Avoid clichés like “revolutionary”.

explain: Pridjevi + primjer + zabrane daju dosljedan glas.
Adjectives + sample + bans give a consistent voice.

title: Društvene mreže i video
Social media and video
summary: Kalendar sadržaja, hookovi, video skripte, repurposing i zajednica.
Content calendar, hooks, video scripts, repurposing and community.

q: Što su stupovi sadržaja (content pillars)?
What are content pillars?
options: 3–5 topics your posts are planned around
explain: Stupovi drže sadržaj fokusiranim.
Pillars keep content focused.

q: Hook je prva rečenica ili prvi sekunde koji zaustavljaju scroll.
A hook is the first line or first seconds that stop the scroll.
explain: Bez hooka ostalo nitko ne vidi.
Without a hook nobody sees the rest.

q: Plan objava po datumima zove se ___ sadržaja.
A plan of posts by date is called a content ___.
explain: Kalendar donosi ritam i dosljednost.
A calendar brings rhythm and consistency.

q: Spojite kanal sa stilom hooka.
Match the channel with a hook style.
pairs: The first 3 seconds, a visual and a question
First line: an insight or story
explain: Svaki kanal ima svoj ritam pažnje.
Each channel has its own attention rhythm.

q: Složite izradu kalendara uz AI.
Order building a calendar with AI.
explain: Analitika zatvara krug.
Analytics closes the loop.

q: Što je bolji pristup?
Which approach is better?
a: Objavljujem što mi padne na pamet.
I post whatever comes to mind.
b: Objava iz stupa „Edukacija” s hookom i CTA-om.
A post from the “Education” pillar with a hook and CTA.
explain: Plan štedi vrijeme i drži poruku.
A plan saves time and keeps the message.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?

t: Daj puno kreativnih ideja.
Give many creative ideas.
Ti si SMM male pekare. Daj 12 ideja za 4 tjedna u 3 stupa (edukacija, iza kulisa, ponuda). Tablica: ideja, format, hook, CTA.
You are the SMM of a small bakery. Give 12 ideas for 4 weeks across 3 pillars (education, behind the scenes, offer). Table: idea, format, hook, CTA.
Daj ideje koje nitko nije vidio.
Give ideas nobody has ever seen.

explain: Tablica ide izravno u planer.
The table goes straight into the planner.

q: AI ideje treba provjeriti prema podacima o publici i dosegu.
AI ideas should be checked against audience and reach data.
explain: Podaci pobjeđuju osjećaj.
Data beats feelings.

q: Struktura kratkog videa?
The structure of a short video?
explain: Kratak video nema vremena za zagrijavanje.
A short video has no time to warm up.

q: Složite repurposing.
Order repurposing.
explain: Jedan izvor, mnogo derivata.
One source, many derivatives.

q: Spojite izvor s derivatom.
Match the source with a derivative.
pairs: A LinkedIn post and an email
explain: Isti sadržaj, različita ambalaža.
The same content in different packaging.

q: Repurposing znači kopirati isti tekst na sve kanale.
Repurposing means copying the same text to every channel.
explain: Svaki kanal traži svoj format i ton.
Each channel needs its own format and tone.

q: Odgovaranje na komentare gradi ___.
Replying to comments builds a ___.
explain: Zajednica je dugoročna imovina.
A community is a long-term asset.

q: Kako AI pomaže pri odgovaranju na komentare?
How does AI help with replying to comments?
options: Priprema nacrte, a osjetljive teme pregledava čovjek
It prepares drafts, and a human reviews sensitive topics
explain: Brzina uz kontrolu.
Speed with control.

q: Što je sigurnije za pritužbe?
Which is safer for complaints?
b: AI predloži odgovor, čovjek ga odobri.
AI suggests a reply, a human approves.
explain: Pritužbe traže empatiju i odgovornost.
Complaints need empathy and accountability.

q: Napišite prompt za skriptu kratkog videa.
Write a prompt for a short video script.

label: Traži hook u prvim sekundama
Asks for a hook in the first seconds
hint: Ask for a hook in the first 3 seconds.

label: Određuje trajanje ili broj kadrova
Sets duration or number of shots
hint: Dodaj trajanje, npr. 20 sekundi i 4 kadra.
Add a duration, e.g. 20 seconds and 4 shots.

model: Napiši skriptu za Reels od 20 sekundi o tome kako AI štedi vrijeme malim timovima. Hook u prve 3 sekunde, 4 kadra s tekstom na ekranu i CTA „Prati za više savjeta”.
Write a 20-second Reels script about how AI saves small teams time. A hook in the first 3 seconds, 4 shots with on-screen text and the CTA “Follow for more tips”.

explain: Skripta po kadrovima je odmah snimljiva.
A shot-by-shot script is ready to film.

title: Oglasi i performance marketing
Ads and performance marketing
summary: Meta i Google oglasi, A/B testovi, metrike i budžet.
Meta and Google ads, A/B tests, metrics and budget.

q: Spojite element s ograničenjem ili pravilom.
Match the element with its limit or rule.
pairs: Prvi redak je ključan prije „Vidi više”
The first line is key before “See more”
explain: Ograničenja provjeri u aktualnoj dokumentaciji platforme.
Check limits in the platform's current documentation.

q: Što najviše utječe na relevantnost Search oglasa?
What most affects the relevance of a Search ad?
options: Podudaranje s namjerom pretrage i landing stranicom
Matching search intent and the landing page
explain: Oglas, ključna riječ i stranica moraju pričati istu priču.
Ad, keyword and page must tell the same story.

q: Oglas i landing stranica trebaju davati isto obećanje.
The ad and landing page should make the same promise.
explain: Nepodudarnost diže odlaske sa stranice.
A mismatch raises bounces.

q: Više naslova koje Google kombinira zove se responsive search ___.
Several headlines that Google combines are called responsive search ___.
explain: Daj raznolike naslove, ne parafraze.
Give varied headlines, not paraphrases.

q: Koliko kutova testirati u Meta oglasu?
How many angles should you test in a Meta ad?
explain: Različiti kutovi daju pravu informaciju.
Different angles give real information.

q: Koji oglas je bolji?
Which ad is better?
b: Book a free slot by Friday.
explain: Jasna radnja, korist i rok.
A clear action, benefit and deadline.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?
bad: Write an ad for our course.

t: Napiši oglas koji prodaje.
Write an ad that sells.
Napiši 5 Meta primarnih tekstova (do 125 znakova) za tečaj AI-ja za marketere. Kutovi: vrijeme, karijera, dokaz. CTA: Prijavi se. Bez izmišljenih brojki.
Write 5 Meta primary texts (up to 125 characters) for an AI course for marketers. Angles: time, career, proof. CTA: Sign up. No invented numbers.
why: Channel, angles, CTA and a ban.

t: Napiši oglas s puno poziva.
Write an ad with many calls.

explain: Ograničenje izmišljanja štiti od neistina.
The no-invention rule guards against falsehoods.

q: Dodirnite tvrdnju koja je pravno rizična.
Tap the claim that is legally risky.
segments: Nauči AI za marketing u 4 tjedna.
Learn AI for marketing in 4 weeks.
We guarantee a job after the course.
explain: Garancije koje ne možeš ispuniti obmanjuju.
Guarantees you can't keep are misleading.

q: Spojite metriku sa značenjem.
Match the metric with its meaning.
explain: Biraj metriku koja prati poslovni cilj.
Pick the metric that tracks the business goal.

q: Kako provoditi A/B test?
How do you run an A/B test?
options: Change one variable at a time
explain: Inače ne znaš što je uzrok razlike.
Otherwise you can't tell what caused the difference.

q: Pobjednika možeš proglasiti nakon 20 klikova.
You can declare a winner after 20 clicks.
explain: Premalo podataka, razlika može biti slučajnost.
Too little data, the difference may be chance.

q: ROAS je prihod podijeljen s troškom ___.
ROAS is revenue divided by ___ spend.
explain: ROAS od 4 znači 4 € prihoda za 1 € oglasa.
A ROAS of 4 means 4 € revenue per 1 € of ads.

q: Složite A/B tijek.
Order the A/B flow.
explain: Dokumentiraj da ne ponavljaš testove.
Document so you don't repeat tests.

q: Koji test je ispravniji?
Which test is more sound?
a: Mijenjam naslov, sliku i CTA istovremeno.
I change headline, image and CTA at once.
explain: Jedna varijabla daje čist zaključak.
One variable gives a clean conclusion.

q: Smiješ li AI-ju zalijepiti izvoz iz oglasnog računa?
May you paste an ad account export into AI?
options: Da, bez osobnih podataka, i provjeri izračune
Yes, without personal data, and verify the calculations
explain: Agregirani podaci su obično sigurni, ali provjeri politiku.
Aggregated data is usually fine, but check the policy.

q: Napišite prompt za plan A/B testa oglasa.
Write a prompt for an ad A/B test plan.

label: Određuje metriku
Sets a metric
hint: Add a success metric, e.g. CPA.

model: Napravi plan A/B testa za Meta oglas tečaja. Hipoteza: naslov s koristom daje niži CPA od naslova s pitanjem. Testiraj samo naslov, jednak budžet, 7 dana. Metrika: CPA i CTR.
Make an A/B test plan for a Meta course ad. Hypothesis: a benefit headline gives a lower CPA than a question headline. Test only the headline, equal budget, 7 days. Metric: CPA and CTR.

explain: Plan s hipotezom i metrikom daje odgovor, a ne dojam.
A plan with a hypothesis and metric gives an answer, not an impression.
